title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1982-12-30
lineage: PCM -> Peak -> Samplitude Professional v10.1 -> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Matrix recording with crystal‑clear sound captures a high‑energy set highlighted by a smoking Touch → Throwing Stones → Franklin’s Tower and brilliant Brent keyboards.
ai_review.review: The audience‑board‑helped PCM delivers an immersive, almost stage‑side listening experience that reviewers describe as excellent and vivid. Musically the show is fire‑hot – the second set with Touch, Throwing Stones and Franklin’s Tower is repeatedly called “tits” and the band is praised for being in top form, especially Brent’s colorful keyboards and Phil’s thundering bass.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are five‑star, uniformly praising both the performance and the recording with no negative points, indicating an exceptional show captured by a high‑quality matrix source.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience board‑helped PCM creates an immersive blend; reviewers note crisp, clear sound with no reported dropouts or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong second set with seamless transitions; overall the concert maintains high momentum and tight playing throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Thundering bass praised as "sooooo good" throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's colorful, effect‑less keyboard work highlighted as brilliant and a key part of the show's vibe.
